findings.description: Requirement: 'Choices audit workflow integration' explicitly mandates that both validation and cleanup gates shall surface open needs-user entries from the ledger. However, spec.md only provides scenario 'needs-user entries surface at the validation gate' and completely omits a scenario for the cleanup gate (which Task 3.3 implements).
findings.resolution: Add a new scenario 'needs-user entries surface at the cleanup gate' to spec.md under the 'Choices audit workflow integration' requirement and map Task 3.3 to it.

findings.description: Scenario ordinal collision and range mismatch. The archived parent spec (openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-10-add-decision-choices-ledger/specs/skill-workflow/spec.md) contains 7 scenarios (skill-workflow.1 through skill-workflow.7). In tasks.md, Task 3.1 is assigned skill-workflow.7 (colliding with parent scenario 7 'Rendering enforces the ranking invariant') and Task 3.2 is assigned skill-workflow.8. Furthermore, Task 3.6 claims to cover 'skill-workflow.1 through skill-workflow.8', omitting the 9th scenario.
findings.resolution: Update scenario references in tasks.md: assign Task 3.1 to skill-workflow.8, Task 3.2 to skill-workflow.9, Task 3.3 to skill-workflow.10 (after adding the cleanup gate scenario to spec.md), and update Task 3.6 to specify 'skill-workflow.1 through skill-workflow.10'.

findings.description: Dangling design decision references and missing design artifact context. tasks.md references design decisions D5 and D6 for Tasks 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, and 3.5, but followup-add-decision-choices-ledger contains no design.md file nor an explicit reference establishing that D1..D9 are inherited from the archived parent change.
findings.resolution: Add a design.md file in openspec/changes/followup-add-decision-choices-ledger/ explicitly referencing parent design decisions D1..D9 from archive/2026-09-10-add-decision-choices-ledger/design.md and documenting how D5/D6 govern Phase 3 workflow hooks.

findings.description: Incomplete testability and verification specification in Task 3.6. Task 3.6 ('Run an end-to-end audit against an archived-change fixture') claims to cover all spec scenarios including non-blocking workflow invocation (Task 3.1) and gate surfacing (Tasks 3.2 and 3.3). However, tasks.md specifies no automated test suite additions (e.g. in skills/tests/audit-choices/ or skills/validate-feature/scripts/tests/) to verify prompt/SKILL.md workflow hook execution automatically.
findings.resolution: Add explicit unit/integration test verification tasks (or sub-steps in Task 3.6) that mock or exercise gate_logic.py and skill workflow hook rendering against choices.json fixtures containing needs-user entries.

findings.description: Ambiguity regarding python driver changes vs SKILL.md prompt wiring for surfacing needs-user entries. Proposal asserts 'No change to the schema, the ledger format, the audit driver, or the skill's read-only posture. This change is wiring and documentation only.' However, gate_logic.py currently has no logic for reading choices.json or surfacing needs-user entries. If gate_logic.py needs modification to surface needs-user entries programmatically at validation and cleanup gates, proposal.md should explicitly clarify that gate_logic.py will be updated.
findings.resolution: Clarify in proposal.md and design.md that gate_logic.py is included in the scope of workflow gate integration changes for surfacing needs-user ledger entries.
